newsitem.title: USA: Periphonics sees Q3 EPS $0.15-$0.22. [CORRECTED 20:42 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Periphonics sees Q3 EPS $0.15-$0.22. [CORRECTED 20:42 GMT]

text.p: Periphonics Corp said Thursday it expected its third quarter earnings to be in the range of $0.15 per share and $0.22 per share.
The First Call mean estimate for the quarter ending February 28 is $0.22 per share, Periphonics said.
In the prior year, the company posted third quarter earnings of $0.17 (corrects from $0.33) per share on a post split basis. The company completed a two-for-one stock split on October 31, 1996.
Periphonics said its long-term outlook for worldwide demand for its interactive voice response systems and services remains positive.

Because of the size and terms of the contracts associated with large interactive voice response systems, the company said it sometimes experiences quarter-to- quarter fluctuations and will continue to be influenced by when it receives orders and makes major deliveries.
